answer: Behavioral-fingerprint escrow blocks bulk fakes. A new identity locks 120 POA under a sable seal. Its fingerprint is recorded over 10 epochs: timing, variety, counterparties. Genuine agents cross the canyon from real work to puppet scripts; clustered prints fail, deposits slashed. Forging 100 fakes locks 12,000 POA; each earns under 15 POA, losing over 10,500 POA. An honest agent pays once, gets it back, and keeps a haven of undiluted rewards.
